name: Citadel Room Render Definitions

generalRoomRenderRule.visualLanguage: ancient, warm, lived-in, human-scaled Citadel architecture
generalRoomRenderRule.forwardHemisphereRule: Standard room renderings show only the forward hemisphere unless map, diagram, overview, 360 panorama, blueprint, door render, exterior overview, or special reference view is requested.
generalRoomRenderRule.viewerRule: Viewer stands at true geometric center and faces canonical North by default. If another direction is requested, only the viewer rotates.

connectedRoomViewDerivationRule: When an open canonical doorway reveals a destination room, derive the visible portion from that destination room's canonical definition.
Do not use generic phrases like 'the room beyond'.
Connected-room descriptions must be canonical, concise, and secondary unless the request focuses on the doorway view.
noOverlayNoTextRule: No Citadel image may include overlays, labels, arrows, compass markings, UI elements, captions, explanatory signs, or words unless explicitly requested.

Entry Hall.purpose: Southernmost entrance and first threshold space.
Entry Hall.connections: North Door -> Small Library; South Door -> Outside / Arrival; West Door -> Garden.
Entry Hall.visualIdentity: Narrow welcoming passage, longer than wide, cozy, ancient, lived-in, cared for, practical, safe, inviting.
Entry Hall.northFacingSpec: North Door centered or near-centered ahead and open by default; Small Library visible beyond; West Door visible on left wall; South Door behind viewer and not visible.

openDoorDerivations.northDoor: Visible bookshelves, reading tables, lecterns, maps, writing tools, lantern-lit study areas, introductory collections, historical records, scholarly materials.
openDoorDerivations.westDoor: Visible vine-covered stone boundary walls, warm daylight, raked sand, stacked Zen stones, modest plants, lanterns or garden lights, calm meditative Garden atmosphere.

Garden.purpose: Meditation branch space connected to Entry Hall.
requiredFeatures: a few tiny faraway steampunk blimps
exactly one small Buddha statue in northwest corner
buddhaVisibilityRules: One Buddha only, fixed in northwest corner.
In a west-facing render it should appear on the right side when visible.
In an east-facing render it should not be visible under the Forward Hemisphere Rule.
In a 360 panorama or exterior overview, it may be visible.

Small Library.purpose: Final preparatory room before entering Great Hall.
Small Library.connections: Entry Hall -> Small Library -> Foundational Door -> Great Hall.

Great Hall.purpose: Central navigation chamber and symbolic heart of exploration.
Great Hall.viewerPosition: True geometric center upon the Great Knowledge Compass.
Great Hall.standardRenderDoorVisibility: Only forward half visible; minimum 1, preferred 2-3, maximum 4 visible doors. Showing all eight doors is non-canonical unless 360 panorama or special reference asset is requested.

Hall of Discovery.connections: South Science Door -> Great Hall; North Astronomy Door; West Biology Door; East Logic Door.
Hall of Discovery.northFacingSpec: Astronomy Door centered ahead; Biology may appear on left wall; Logic may appear on right wall; Science Door behind viewer unless wide/360.

doorDetails.Astronomy Door: Celestial motifs, brass star maps, constellations, astrolabe details; open view reveals astronomical instruments and star-study themes.
doorDetails.Biology Door: Botanical and life-study motifs; open view reveals botanical study tables, natural-study collections, biological illustrations, specimens, greenery.
doorDetails.Logic Door: Geometric and symbolic patterns; open view reveals analytical workspaces, structured diagrams, symbolic boards, calm ordered study environment.
doorDetails.Science Door: Return to Great Hall; open view reveals Great Knowledge Compass, ancient stone architecture, brass mechanisms, banners, domain medallions.
